spanish: Y dieron sobre ella cordón de azul, para dar sobre el turbante desde arriba, conforme a lo que mandó Jehová a Moisés.

findings.issue: עָלָיו is a preposition with a 3rd masculine singular suffix; «ella» makes that referent feminine.

notes: The rest of the verse matches the tokens: 3mp qal נתן, construct cord of blue, infinitive נתן, the turban, from above, and Piel command of Jehová to Moisés.
